dedupe_keys.name: siso viewer control loop data preparation and analysis

description: SISO Viewer is a Python application for preparing and examining single-input single-output control-loop measurements. It loads HDF5 datasets, supports resampling and selection of data ranges, and presents time-domain, frequency-domain, correlation and parametric analyses. Documented conversion routines combine CSV signals with Excel loop metadata and can convert the Jelali-Huang MATLAB stiction collection. Coverage is generic control-loop analysis without geographic or acquisition-period limits. The GitHub code is free under LGPL-3.0, with local deployment through a Dash browser interface. A limitation is that the external industrial dataset page was unavailable during this review, so working software documentation does not establish access to every advertised input dataset. Simulation uses include preparing process-control observations and evaluating condition-monitoring features. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with control-loop preparation. Only the README and repository inventory were checked; the portable archive, bundled example data and Python application were not downloaded or executed.
